sources.title: MIRA
sources.snippet: Multiplayer world model - a dream of Rocket League. Play the live demo - a dream of Rocket League. Trained on 10k hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, MIRA learns the dynamics of a four-player game. The model runs in real time at 20fps, based on the keys you and the other players press. Blog Technical report Code Dataset Of course, a simulation cannot replace the real ...

sources.snippet: readme.mp4 MIRA is a real-time world model of Rocket League: a 5B parameters latent diffusion model generates the video frame by frame from all four players' actions, so a full 2v2 match can be played inside the model at 20 FPS on a single GPU.
